title: Value-added Opportunistic CT Screening: State of the Art

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Value-added Opportunistic CT Screening: State of the Art》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】The growing interest in CT-based opportunistic screening relates to a confluence of factors: the objective and generalizable nature of CT-based body composition measures, the emergence of fully automated explainable AI solutions, the sheer volume of body CT scans performed, and the increasing emphasis on precision medicine and value-added initiatives.
